investigator.method: Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC only: a plain curl GET of the venue's own official agenda page revealed a Nuxt SPA whose retained window.__NUXT__.config exposes its own public Sanity.io projectId/dataset ('7jg0n68u'/'production', useCdn:true). Sanity's public GROQ query CDN API (no auth token) was then queried directly with a plain curl GET, using GROQ's own '->' dereference operator to resolve room/artist references server-side in one request — no browser, no client-side reference-walking, no second per-record fetch.

probe_history.reason: The venue's own official agenda page (https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/en/agenda/) is a Nuxt SPA; its retained, server-sent window.__NUXT__.config block (no JS execution needed to read it) directly states its own Sanity project id and dataset. A plain, unauthenticated GET against Sanity's own public GROQ query CDN endpoint for that exact project/dataset returned 200 with real, structured 'live' (booked concert) documents — title, date, schedules, room (dereferenced), ticketUrl, slug — for every upcoming Razzmatazz concert. This directly answers the investigation question at Level 1: no structural/browser escalation was needed.

venue_reference: Razzmatazz (major independent concert venue, Poblenou, Barcelona — 5 rooms; this investigation covers the 3 rooms hosting booked concerts, Sala 1/2/3)

identity.notes: Official identity confirmed directly from the retained evidence at https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/en/agenda/ (the venue's own domain) and its own retained address text ('RAZZMATAZZ / Main entrance: C/ Almogàvers 122 / Entrance rooms 2 & 3: C/ Pamplona 88'), independently cross-checked against a genuinely distinct source (Jamboree's own Tribe Events REST API cross-listing a 'Razzmatazz 2' room booking for the identical event title/date/festival — see venues/source-venue-mappings.json).

site_classification.platform: Sanity.io headless CMS, queried via its own public GROQ query CDN API (not the site's rendered Nuxt frontend) — see ingestion/sanity/client.mjs (a new, deliberately generic, reusable module for this platform family) and ingestion/razzmatazz/discovery.mjs.

title.notes: Each 'live' document's own 'title' field; a small minority of records leave 'title' empty and rely entirely on their own dereferenced 'artists[]->title' instead (both directly retained fields on the SAME document — this package's collector falls back to the latter only when the former is genuinely absent, never overriding a present title).

start_date.notes: Each document's own 'date' field, an explicit 'YYYY-MM-DD' string stated directly — no combination/inference needed.

time.notes: Each document's own 'schedules.eventStart' field, a local 'HH:MM' string with NO timezone/offset at all — honestly FLOATING_LOCAL, never upgraded to UTC.

venue_location.notes: Not present per-record (this source resolves to ONE physical venue via source_id — its 3 numbered concert rooms are sub-locations within the same building, matching this project's existing Casa da Música/Jamboree 'room is not a separate venue' precedent).

source_record_id.notes: Each document's own Sanity '_id' — Sanity's own document identifier, permanently stable by the platform's own design (documents are addressed by _id for every read/write/reference operation; this is the platform's own stable identity, not an inferred one).

event_url.notes: Derived deterministically from each document's own 'slug.current', concatenated with this source's fixed, evidenced agenda base path 'https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/en/agenda/{slug}/' — live-verified to resolve (HTTP 200) for a sampled slug.

price.notes: A 'prices' object exists on the raw document but is itself reference-heavy (priceDescription/title references) and was not included in this collector's own bounded GROQ projection — genuinely not collected, not fabricated as absent from the source.

reasons: Identity PROVEN, independently cross-checked against a second, genuinely distinct source.
acquisition_class PUBLIC_JSON_API, a resolved supported class.
A CONFIRMED public data path retained (10 real upcoming 'live' records sampled).
title and start_date both PROVEN, directly stated by the source (no context combination needed).
source_record_id PROVEN via the platform's own stable document _id.
recommended_family NEW_FAMILY_REQUIRED — but implemented as a genuinely reusable, generic module (ingestion/sanity/client.mjs) for any future Sanity-backed Barcelona source, not a one-off hack.

evidence.description: The venue's own official agenda page's server-sent window.__NUXT__.config block, stating its own public Sanity projectId ('7jg0n68u') and dataset ('production'), plus the venue's own retained address text.
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: The full, live response of a bounded GROQ query against this source's own public Sanity CDN API — 10 real upcoming 'live' (booked concert) records, dereferencing room/artists server-side.
evidence.method: curl (plain HTTP GET, descriptive User-Agent, no authentication, no browser)

evidence.description: Live HTTP 200 verification that the derived event_url pattern ('https://www.salarazzmatazz.com/en/agenda/{slug}/') genuinely resolves to the real event detail page for a sampled slug.

This package's own offline test suite (tests/razzmatazz.test.mjs) re-parses the retained ev-live-sample fixture with the actual collector code (ingestion/razzmatazz/discovery.mjs, ingestion/razzmatazz/observation-adapter.mjs) and asserts the exact fields recorded above — a real, dependency-free, no-network, deterministic reproduction.
